photos.c: Right: Catherine Berry set a club best for 5000 metres at the trial, placed 10th in the Games, and improved her best again at the Crystal Palace IAAF Grand Prix. Latest news is that on May 17th 2003 at Gresham, Oregon, she improved yet again to 15:30:25.
Catherine Berry ran second fastest of the day at Reigate Priory but was not quite able to take the Belles into the lead.
